(1) MarkedDiagram (stmt l.141-153). D : Diagram is a nonempty (c ≥ 1, LinkDiagram.lean:87,580-582) actual generic polygonal diagram. I : D.Γ.Arc is the closed forward cyclic interval start→stop on component I.i (LinkMoves.lean:145-151), start ≠ stop (IsArc l.198-202). IsMarkedInterval D I (LinkMoves.lean:1107-1109) = no visit point on the closed arc (∀ v, ¬ I.Mem (visitPt v)) ∧ ∃ U, IsDisc U (compact convex, l.100) ∧ Clean U D (l.342-344) ∧ ArcCover U {I} (l.208-211: D ∩ U is exactly I with ends on ∂U). This is narrower than the literal printed 'contained in a clean disc', but every printed (D,I) admits a Lean sub-arc I' ⊆ I (a small square around an interior edge point) with the same record mark (no occurrence lies on I, so the last occurrence before I'.start is the last before I.start), and the row reads only μ; so no printed instance is lost. Non-blocking (weaker quantification only).

(2) μ is determined by I. μ : D.record.Mark (LinkRecord.lean:1226-1230, gap_comp/gap_none), comp_eq : I.i = μ.comp, gap_iff : ∀ v, μ.gap = some v ↔ IsGapOf I v, where IsGapOf I v (stmt l.125-128) := compOf v = I.i ∧ ∀ w on I.i, ¬cycBetween (visitCoord v) (visitCoord w) (traversalKey I.start). cycBetween (LinkDiagramRecord.lean:78-79) is strict forward cyclic betweenness on ℝ; visitCoord v = traversalKey (visitPt v).2 ∈ [0,k) (l.181-186), injective on a component (l.189-198); traversalBetween ↔ cycBetween is Iff.rfl (l.81-83). Because no visit lies on I, visitCoord v ≠ traversalKey I.start, and for three distinct reals exactly one of cycBetween a b c / cycBetween b a c holds; hence the IsGapOf witness is unique when the component has occurrences and exists (max key below start's key, else max key overall); when the component is crossing-free IsGapOf is unsatisfiable so gap = none is forced (consistent with Mark.gap_none). MarkedDiagram is therefore inhabited exactly once per printed (D,I): μ adds no freedom and drops no instance, and 'the occurrence just before I' is the gap (v, s v) containing I, i.e. the printed 'marked gap'.

(3) IsCleanMarkedJoin A B J := Nonempty (RecordIso J.record (Record.joinRecord A.μ B.μ)) (stmt l.161-162). joinRecord (LinkRecord.lean:1513-1520): M = M_A ⊕ M_B; succ = joinSucc = sumSucc * gapSwap (l.1279), i.e. (s_A ⊕ s_B) ∘ swap(inl g_A, inr g_B) when both gaps are some (Perm.mul_apply), so g_A ↦ s_B g_B, g_B ↦ s_A g_A, all other successors unchanged = 'concatenate the marked component cycles at their marked gaps' (traversal ... v_A → [B from s_B v_B to v_B] → s_A v_A ..., orientation preserved as in sm-3:1414-1417); gapSwap = 1 when a marked circle is crossing-free (l.1234-1236) = 'an arbitrary crossing-free marked component'; pair = sumCongr pair_A pair_B, isOver/sgn = Sum.elim = 'keep exactly all old crossing pairings, bits and signs'; comps = comps_A ⊕ Unmarked_B with B's marked circle merged into A's (joinComp l.1294-1296) = 'retain every other component'; componentCount_joinRecord gives c(A)+c(B)−1 (l.1560-1573). RecordIso (l.539-552) is the printed named record isomorphism with the component bijection including crossing-free circles (sm-3:361-365, 1218-1221). Diagram.record (LinkDiagramRecord.lean:500-514) has succ = nextVisit (forward cyclic key order, l.255-259), pair = twin, isOver = overBit, sgn = D.sign = sgn det(u_o,u_u) (LinkDiagram.lean:552-553). Every printed actual clean join J(A,B) has exactly this named record ('Its finite data are precise', 'This realizes the stated record concatenation' sm-3:1419-1420), so the Lean class is a superset of the printed one; the surplus is closed under rp:record-polynomial (sm-3:1217-1221) given existence (sm-3:1385), which is how the source itself compares realizations (1420-1421, 1479-1480). Not refuted. I expanded every definition the row uses to primitives and could not find a blocking discrepancy; the three reviewers' non-blocking items are real but non-blocking, and no new one appeared.

(1) Record-level join = printed finite data. Mathlib `Equiv.Perm.mul_apply : (f * g) x = f (g x)` (Mathlib/Algebra/Group/End.lean:102), so `joinSucc := sumSucc ρ₁ ρ₂ * gapSwap μ₁.gap μ₂.gap` (work/lean/SM/LinkRecord.lean:1279, gapSwap 1234-1236) applies the gap transposition first: `inl g_A ↦ inr (s_B g_B)`, `inr g_B ↦ inl (s_A g_A)`, all other occurrences keep their old successor. The joined cycle is `… → g_A → s_B g_B → … → g_B → s_A g_A → …`, i.e. the incoming collar of A continues into B just after B's gap and B's incoming collar continues into A just after A's gap — exactly the printed "cuts a smaller open interval inside each mark and joins the oriented ends crosswise, preserving the surviving collars… concatenate the marked component cycles at their marked gaps" (paragraph excerpt lines 13-17 = sm-3:1373-1378) with "no reversal of A" (sm-3:1416-1417). `pair := Perm.sumCongr`, `isOver := Sum.elim`, `sgn := Sum.elim` (LinkRecord.lean:1518-1520) = "keep exactly all old crossing pairings, bits and signs"; `comps := ρ₁.comps ⊕ μ₂.Unmarked` (1514, Unmarked 1282) = "retain every other component", count c(A)+c(B)−1 (componentCount_joinRecord 1560). With a `none` gap `gapSwap = 1` (1241-1245) and `joinComp` (1294-1296) merges the crossing-free marked circle — the printed "arbitrary crossing-free marked component" case.

(2) MarkedDiagram is exactly the printed marked diagram, with μ determined and no vacuity. `cycBetween a b c := (a<b∧b<c) ∨ (b<c∧c<a) ∨ (c<a∧a<b)` (LinkDiagramRecord.lean:78-79) is strict forward betweenness; `visitCoord` (181) and `traversalKey I.start` live on the same `[0,k)` circle when `compOf v = I.i`, and keys are injective per component (visitCoord_injOn 189). `IsMarkedInterval` (LinkMoves.lean:1107-1109) forbids every visit on the closed arc, so `I.start` never ties an occurrence key. Hence `Diagram.IsGapOf I v` (statement l.125-128) holds for exactly one v when the marked component has occurrences (the occurrence with the largest key below the start key, or the overall largest key if none precedes — checked against all three disjuncts) and for none when it is crossing-free. Together with `Record.Mark.gap_comp/gap_none` (LinkRecord.lean:1226-1230), `comp_eq` and `gap_iff` (statement l.151-153) admit exactly one μ per (D, I); `D.record.comp v = D.compOf v` is rfl (LinkDiagramRecord.lean:520), `D.record.succ = nextVisit` (522) is the key-order cyclic successor used by joinRecord. So `MarkedDiagram ≅ {(D,I) | IsMarkedInterval D I}`; the reviewers' "μ is data with no printed counterpart" is correct and harmless. `Shadow.hc : 0 < c` (LinkDiagram.lean:87, "Here c ≥ 1") gives "nonempty"; `Diagram` (490-498) is the polygonal actual diagram; `P : Diagram → R` (LocalPolynomial.lean:22) is total, matching lp:core (sm-3:1041-1063, every c-component diagram).

(3) Quantifier scope. Lean `MarkedDiagram` ⊆ printed (IsMarkedInterval: no visit on I, convex compact U with D ∩ U = I and ends on ∂U, `Clean U D` = LinkMoves.lean:342-344 — all imply "closed nonsingular oriented interval on one component, no crossing, in a clean disc"). The narrowing (D ∩ U = I exactly) is non-blocking: for any printed (D, I) a straight sub-segment I' ⊆ I inside one edge with a small closed ball is a Lean IsMarkedInterval with the same μ (same component; the last occurrence before I'.start is the one before I.start because I carries none), and the identical J then satisfies `IsCleanMarkedJoin`, so every printed instance of mp:join-value is an instance of `join_value`. `IsCleanMarkedJoin A B J := Nonempty (RecordIso J.record (joinRecord A.μ B.μ))` (l.161-162; RecordIso LinkRecord.lean:539-552 includes the component bijection e over crossing-free circles as rp:record-polynomial 1220-1221 requires) is a superset of the cut-and-paste realizations; the printed text itself fixes this reading — "This realizes the stated record concatenation. The old A presentation, the new one and any other actual clean realization are compared only by Lemma lc:presentations" (sm-3:1419-1421) and the proof "Use the actual smoothed diagram as the realization of J(A⁰,B), or apply Lemma lc:presentations to a newly chosen clean realization" (1479-1480). Lean is therefore stronger by exactly the accepted rp:record-polynomial/lc:presentations closure (1215-1229, 1306-1320), never weaker; design decision D9 is the printed reading.

(4) Clause-by-clause of the theorem environment (excerpt l.1-11 = sm-3:1427-1437): sentence 1 → `join_value` (statement l.358-359); sentence 2 → `multi_component_factors` (l.363-365, covers all factors with >1 component, "smoothing-created" is provenance) and `crossing_free_marked_component` (l.368-370, `gap = none` ⇔ crossing-free marked component by (2)); sentence 3 is a negative remark rendered by the absence of any tangle/isotopy hypothesis. No Lean field lacks a printed counterpart (the two instance fields are printed inclusions, redundant with join_value); no printed clause lacks a Lean field. The existence prose (sm-3:1385-1426) is outside the theorem environment. Docstring citation offsets (statement l.40, 48, 132, 138, 158, 165; LinkMoves.lean:1103) are cosmetic; the excerpt files and statements are unaffected.
